crons._comment: Every 5 minutes. RSS is free and triage only scores NEW stories, so polling faster costs nothing extra — the same ~22 stories/hour arrive either way, just noticed sooner. Not worth going below 5 min: the outlets' own publish-to-feed lag is about that long, so faster polling would only re-read identical files. Vercel Hobby runs cron daily only — see DEPLOY.md for the free external scheduler.
